notes.surfaces: The full ego_* MCP and SDK operate on the selected task's tab. The ego_desktop_* MCP operates on the visible desktop page. A tool appearing in tools/list does not grant control or prove that the connected backend supports every operation.
notes.refs: When scoped-refs-v1 is negotiated, @refs identify a runtime, task, page, frame and document. Partial snapshots merge references; complete-page snapshots replace that page's reference set. Navigation, frame removal, reconnect or a page change can invalidate refs. Never reinterpret a public ref as a native backendNodeId. Without negotiation, refs use the legacy native-v0 behavior.
notes.frames: On the desktop scoped backend, use snapshot @refs for same-process, cross-process and nested iframe elements. Ordinary CSS/role locators remain rooted in the main frame. Child-frame stable locators are omitted. browser.iframeTarget() is not supported for desktop iframe discovery because Target.getTargets exposes top-level pages only.
notes.drag: Scoped drag supports exactly two refs in the same page, frame, document and native session. Cross-frame drag, mixed ref/coordinate endpoints and multi-point paths containing scoped refs are rejected.
notes.screenshot: The MCP screenshot tools capture a page, not a target ref. SDK scoped locator screenshots support the root native session and same-process frames sharing it. OOPIF element screenshots are unavailable; use a page screenshot.
notes.network: Scoped network waits observe the live sessions of the selected page at wait start. They do not promise to capture initial requests from frames created later. Response bodies use the original source session. Register the wait before triggering the request.
notes.control: Task spaces have separate tabs and control leases. Login state belongs to the selected browser Profile; spaces using that Profile can share its login state. This does not import another browser's cookies. Read-only observation grants no write access. After handoff, request and obtain control through the existing policy before writing.
notes.errors: EGO_REFERENCE_STALE requires a fresh snapshot. EGO_FRAME_UNAVAILABLE requires re-observation after the frame becomes ready. EGO_ACTION_RESULT_UNKNOWN means input may have reached the page; inspect the result and do not automatically replay it. Raw CDP remains authorized but does not gain scoped-ref identity guarantees.
notes.continuous: Keep composed SDK workflows for deterministic work. Use ego_run with explicit steps, mode repair and independent success checks when locator recovery is needed. targetHint enables local exact-label recovery, then at most one Jev target-selection decision if its non-ref locator is absent before dispatch. Intact steps use no Jev. Repair never retries an action error or invents steps; direct disables model fallback, auto retains goal-only exploration. Semantic decisions need the selected Profile's TypeSafe key and cloud consent. Use ego_extract for main-frame rows and pagination. If its connected schema supports relevance, use named extracted fields for bounded semantic screening of noisy lists; unknown rows survive. Check both complete and relevance.complete, plus unknownRows; relevance is not factual verification. Do not use a second writer during a run. Cancel with ego_automation_cancel. A done status requires verified evidence; inspect handoffs, partial extraction and unknown outcomes. Supply authorizedActions only for explicitly authorized consequential actions. These tools do not add backend capabilities.

full.name: ego_agent_status
full.description: Read Agent connection and browser activity known to Ego. External Codex Desktop conversations are unavailable without a status provider.

full.name: ego_automation_cancel
full.description: Cancel this MCP session's continuous task. Already dispatched operations may have happened; observe their results before retrying.

full.name: ego_browser_fetch
full.description: Run fetch inside the current page origin so browser cookies, CORS, and session state apply.

full.name: ego_check
full.description: Set a checkbox or radio element to the requested checked state.

full.name: ego_click
full.description: Click one element using an @ref from the latest snapshot or a strict locator.

full.name: ego_click_new_tab
full.description: Click an element, wait for a newly opened tab or popup, and optionally select it.

full.name: ego_click_wait_for_response
full.description: Atomically start waiting for a matching network response, click an element, and return response details. Scoped network waits observe the live sessions of the selected page at wait start. They do not promise to capture initial requests from frames created later. Response bodies use the original source session. Register the wait before triggering the request.

full.name: ego_dialog_respond
full.description: Accept or dismiss the currently open JavaScript dialog, with optional prompt text.

full.name: ego_dialog_status
full.description: Inspect the currently open JavaScript alert, confirm, prompt, or before-unload dialog.

full.name: ego_double_click
full.description: Double-click one element using an @ref from the latest snapshot or a strict locator.

full.name: ego_download
full.description: Click a download element and wait for the file to complete, optionally saving it to a local path.

full.name: ego_drag
full.description: Drag one element to another element using current snapshot @refs or strict locators. Scoped drag supports exactly two refs in the same page, frame, document and native session. Cross-frame drag, mixed ref/coordinate endpoints and multi-point paths containing scoped refs are rejected.

full.name: ego_evaluate
full.description: Evaluate a JavaScript expression in the current page and return its JSON-serializable value.

full.name: ego_extract
full.description: Read table/list rows with optional pagination. Pass task to select an existing task by name/ID in this MCP session; SDK selection is separate. maxPages is 1-30, maxRows is 1-5000. Fields use CSS selectors relative to each row. Optional relevance sends only its named extracted fields to Jev in bounded batches with the selected Profile's cloud consent. It excludes confidently irrelevant rows, always retains unknown rows, and returns original rowIndices, per-row judgments and sourceIndex provenance. complete covers collection; also inspect relevance.complete and unknownRows. Model relevance is not factual verification. Without relevance, no model is used. Keep composed SDK workflows for deterministic work. Use ego_run with explicit steps, mode repair and independent success checks when locator recovery is needed. targetHint enables local exact-label recovery, then at most one Jev target-selection decision if its non-ref locator is absent before dispatch. Intact steps use no Jev. Repair never retries an action error or invents steps; direct disables model fallback, auto retains goal-only exploration. Semantic decisions need the selected Profile's TypeSafe key and cloud consent. Use ego_extract for main-frame rows and pagination. If its connected schema supports relevance, use named extracted fields for bounded semantic screening of noisy lists; unknown rows survive. Check both complete and relevance.complete, plus unknownRows; relevance is not factual verification. Do not use a second writer during a run. Cancel with ego_automation_cancel. A done status requires verified evidence; inspect handoffs, partial extraction and unknown outcomes. Supply authorizedActions only for explicitly authorized consequential actions. These tools do not add backend capabilities.

full.name: ego_hover
full.description: Hover an element using an @ref from the latest snapshot or a strict locator.

full.name: ego_inspect
full.description: Read text, value, state, and selected attributes from one element identified by @ref or locator.

full.name: ego_scroll
full.description: Scroll the page by CSS-pixel deltas, or reveal a target element.

full.name: ego_select
full.description: Select one or more values in a select element identified by @ref or locator.

full.name: ego_tab_close
full.description: Close a tab in the selected task by current target id, title, or URL.

full.name: ego_tab_select
full.description: Switch the selected task to a tab by current target id, title, or URL.

full.name: ego_tabs
full.description: List tabs in the selected Ego task space.

full.name: ego_task_close
full.description: Close a browser task and all of its tabs after verified work is complete.

full.name: ego_task_complete
full.description: Complete a browser task and either keep it for the user or close it after verified work.

full.name: ego_task_handoff
full.description: Hand the selected browser task to the user and stop agent browser mutations.

full.name: ego_task_observe
full.description: Read workspace control state and tabs without selecting it or obtaining write access. Optionally capture a read-only snapshot of a tab in that workspace.

full.name: ego_task_request_control
full.description: Request write access; the user or current writer must explicitly approve the handoff.

full.name: ego_task_return_control
full.description: Release this Agent's write access to the user or approve a pending request from another Agent.

full.name: ego_task_use
full.description: Select an existing Ego task space by name/id or create it when missing.

full.name: ego_type
full.description: Type text sequentially into an editable element, preserving keyboard events.

full.name: ego_upload
full.description: Set one or more existing local files on a file input identified by @ref or locator.

full.name: ego_wait
full.description: Wait for page loading or for a short bounded duration after an action.

full.name: ego_wait_for
full.description: Wait until a URL, element state, or text condition is satisfied without relying on a fixed sleep.

full.name: ego_webmcp_call
full.description: Call one WebMCP tool exposed by the current page. Discover tools first with ego_webmcp_tools.

tool.description: Exact WebMCP tool name returned by ego_webmcp_tools

input.description: JSON object matching the site's tool input schema

full.name: ego_webmcp_tools
full.description: List the WebMCP tools exposed by the current page through document.modelContext.
